use Raster.ANIMATION
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math

use STATE = (angle: double, rate: double)

let gravity = 9.81D
let length = 1.0D
let swing = 1.0D

let width = 240
let height = 180

let frames = 40
let substeps = 25

advance(state: STATE, dt: double) -> STATE is
    let rate = state.rate - dt * gravity / length * Math.sin(state.angle)

    (angle = state.angle + dt * rate, rate = rate)
si

quarter_period(dt: double) -> double is
    let state mut = (angle = swing, rate = 0.0D)
    let elapsed mut = 0.0D

    while state.angle > 0.0D do
        state = advance(state, dt)
        elapsed = elapsed + dt
    od

    elapsed
si

draw(image: IMAGE, angle: double) is
    let x = length * Math.sin(angle)
    let y = -length * Math.cos(angle)

    image.clear()

    image.colour(140ub, 140ub, 150ub)
    image.stroke(2.0D)
    image.line(0.0D, 0.0D, x, y)

    image.colour(60ub, 60ub, 70ub)
    image.dot(0.0D, 0.0D, 5.0D)

    image.colour(200ub, 50ub, 40ub)
    image.dot(x, y, 12.0D)
si

let period = 4.0D * quarter_period(0.0002D)

let tick = period / cast double(frames * substeps)
let delay = cast int(Math.round(1000.0D * period / cast double(frames)))

let image = IMAGE(width, height)

image.view(-1.05D, -1.15D, 1.05D, 0.25D)

let animation = ANIMATION(width, height)

let state mut = (angle = swing, rate = 0.0D)

for _ in 0..frames do
    draw(image, state.angle)

    animation.add(image, delay)

    for _ in 0..substeps do
        state = advance(state, tick)
    od
od

animation.write("pendulum.png")

animation.show("pendulum.png")
